title: Efficacy and safety of Grafalon® versus Thymoglobulin® for induction therapy in kidney transplant recipients at high risk of delayed graft function: a phase IV randomized open-label study
official: Phase IV, randomized, open-label study comparing the use of Grafalon® versus Thymoglobulin® in non-sensitized patients who have received a kidney transplant at high risk of delayed graft function
summary: Main objective: To compare the time-course evolution of lymphocytes in patients receiving Grafalon® versus Thymoglobulin® during the first year post–kidney transplant

interventions.name: TIMOGLOBULINA 5 mg/ml, polvo para solución para perfusión
Grafalon 20 mg/ml concentrado para solución para perfusión

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Older than 65 years
2. Signed informed consent
3. Patients receiving a kidney graft at high risk of delayed graft function, defined as: - expanded criteria donors (>60 years, or >50 years plus one of: hypertension, diabetes mellitus, Creatinine > or equal 1.5 mg/dL, death by stroke) - Prolonged ICU stay (4-5 days, hemodynamic instability) - cold ischemia time > 19 hours, acute renal failure in donor - pediatric en bloc donors - Retransplants - Low immunological risk recipients without HLA incompatibility - Controlled asystole donors
Exclusion criteria:
1. Recipient with donor-specific anti-HLA antibodies
2. Any other medical or social condition that renders the patient unsuitable for participation or completion of the full study period
3. Use of perfusion machine between explant and implant
4. Prior hematopoietic stem cell or solid organ transplant (except kidney)
5. Laboratory abnormalities: WBC <3000×10⁹/L, Neutrophils <1000×10⁹/L, Platelets <100×10⁹/L
6. Patients at risk of recurrent atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome requiring C5 inhibitor prophylaxis.
7. Active clinically significant bacterial, viral, or fungal infection.
8. Known hypersensitivity to tacrolimus, mycophenolate mofetil/mycophenolic acid, mTOR inhibitors (everolimus), or prednisone.
9. Known hypersensitivity to Thymoglobulin® or Grafalon® or any of their excipients.
10. Pregnancy or intention to become pregnant during the study
